title: Thiên Trù Pagoda
geometryBasis: The Open Buildings envelope at the temple identity supplies roof widths and orientation. The documented Tam Bảo plan links the covered front hall with the deeper central shrine.
sectionBasis: Hoàng Việt’s native public-domain photograph shows the low tile eaves and raised gabled story, upturned eave tips and dark timber front with red columns. The current temple account dates the rebuilding.
limitations: This placement is the main Tam Bảo hall. The surrounding entrance structures, ancillary shrines and caves are separate sites.
Rear subdivision, roof height, roof sculptures and the platform profile are approximate.
